18892-a-thoughtless-yes.title: A Thoughtless Yes
18892-a-thoughtless-yes.creator: Helen H. Gardener
18892-a-thoughtless-yes.description: A book by Helen H. Gardener. I have, this morning, read your review of "A Thoughtless Yes." I wish to thank you for the pleasant things said and also to make the connection--which I am surprised to see did not present itself to your mind--between the title and the burden of the stories or sketches.

arxiv-2107-00027.title: A Long-period Substellar Object Exhibiting a Single Transit in Kepler Facilities: Kepler, FLWO:1.5m (TRES), Keck:I (HIRES), Gaia EXOFASTv2 ( Eastman 2017 ; Eastman et al. 2019 )
arxiv-2107-00027.creator: Samuel N. Quinn, Saul Rappaport, Andrew Vanderburg, Jason D. Eastman, Lorne A. Nelson, Thomas L. Jacobs, Daryll M. LaCourse, Allan R. Schmitt, Perry Berlind, Michael L. Calkins, Gilbert A. Esquerdo, Andrew W. Howard, Howard Isaacson, David W. Latham
arxiv-2107-00027.description: Abstract We report the detection of a single transit-like signal in the Kepler data of the slightly evolved F star KIC4918810. The transit duration is ∼ ​ 45 \mathord{\sim}45 hours, and while the orbital period ( P ​ ∼ ​ 10 P\mathord{\sim}10 years) is not well constrained, it is one of the longest among companions known to transit.

arxiv-2109-08159.title: A Cautionary Tale of Decorrelating Theory Uncertainties
arxiv-2109-08159.creator: Aishik Ghosh, and Benjamin Nachman
arxiv-2109-08159.description: Abstract A variety of techniques have been proposed to train machine learning classifiers that are independent of a given feature. While this can be an essential technique for enabling background estimation, it may also be useful for reducing uncertainties. We carefully examine theory uncertainties, which typically do not have a statistical origin.

arxiv-2303-11913.title: Local mean value estimates for Weyl sums
arxiv-2303-11913.creator: Julia Brandes, Changhao Chen, Igor E. Shparlinski
arxiv-2303-11913.description: Abstract . We obtain new estimates – both upper and lower bounds – on the mean values of the Weyl sums over a small box inside of the unit torus. In particular, we refine recent conjectures of C. Demeter and B. Langowski (2022), and improve some of their results. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 11L15; Secondary: 11L07, 11D45 1.

arxiv-2310-00696.title: Do the Benefits of Joint Models for Relation Extraction Extend to Document-level Tasks?
arxiv-2310-00696.creator: Pratik Saini, Tapas Nayak, Indrajit Bhattacharya
arxiv-2310-00696.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Pratik Saini, Tapas Nayak, Indrajit Bhattacharya. Two distinct approaches have been proposed for relational triple extraction - pipeline and joint. Joint models, which capture interactions across triples, are the more recent development, and have been shown to outperform pipeline models for sentence-level extraction tasks. Document-level extraction is a more challenging setting where interactions across triples can be long-range, and individual triples can also span across sentences. Joint models have not been applied for document-level tasks so far.

arxiv-2405-06404.title: Inclusive content reduces racial and gender biases, yet non-inclusive content dominates popular culture
arxiv-2405-06404.creator: Nouar AlDahoul, Hazem Ibrahim, Minsu Park, Talal Rahwan, Yasir Zaki
arxiv-2405-06404.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nouar AlDahoul, Hazem Ibrahim, Minsu Park, Talal Rahwan, Yasir Zaki. Images are often termed as representations of perceived reality. As such, racial and gender biases in popular culture and visual media could play a critical role in shaping people’s perceptions of society.

arxiv-2411-05086.title: Strong Scatterings Invalidate Proposed Models of Enhanced TDE Rates in Post-Starburst Galaxies
arxiv-2411-05086.creator: Odelia Teboul, Hagai B. Perets
arxiv-2411-05086.description: Abstract Stars wandering too close to supermassive black holes (SMBHs) can be ripped apart by the tidal forces of the black hole. Recent optical surveys have revealed that E+A galaxies are overrepresented by a factor ∼ \sim 30, while green galaxies are overrepresented in both optical and infrared surveys.

arxiv-2502-03760.title: RAMOTS: A Real-Time System for Aerial Multi-Object Tracking based on Deep Learning and Big Data Technology These authors contributed equally to this work.
arxiv-2502-03760.creator: Nhat-Tan Do 1 2 , Nhi Ngoc-Yen Nguyen 1 2 , Dieu-Phuong Nguyen 1 2 , and Trong-Hop Do 1 2
arxiv-2502-03760.description: Abstract Multi-object tracking (MOT) in UAV-based video is challenging due to variations in viewpoint, low resolution, and the presence of small objects. While other research on MOT dedicated to aerial videos primarily focuses on the academic aspect by developing sophisticated algorithms, there is a lack of attention to the practical aspect of these systems.

arxiv-2503-12309.title: How Scientists Use Jupyter Notebooks: Goals, Quality Attributes, and Opportunities
arxiv-2503-12309.creator: Ruanqianqian (Lisa) Huang 1 , Savitha Ravi 1 , Michael He, Boyu Tian, Sorin Lerner , Michael Coblenz
arxiv-2503-12309.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ruanqianqian (Lisa) Huang 1 , Savitha Ravi 1 , Michael He, Boyu Tian, Sorin Lerner , Michael Coblenz. Computational notebooks are intended to prioritize the needs of scientists, but little is known about how scientists interact with notebooks, what requirements drive scientists’ software development processes, or what tactics scientists use to meet their requirements. We conducted an observational study of 20 scientists using Jupyter notebooks for their day-to-day tasks, finding that scientists prioritize different quality attributes depending on their goals.

arxiv-2509-04249.title: Mediation, splitting and shellability in political structures modeled by simplicial complexes Thanks: Acknowledgements. The authors would like to thank Ismar Volić for looking over the manuscript and providing helpful suggestions.
arxiv-2509-04249.creator: Duško Jojić, Franjo Šarčević
arxiv-2509-04249.description: Abstract . Modeling political structures by simplicial complexes, we investigate whether introducing a mediator into a substructure increases or decreases the stability of the overall structure. We prove theorems that quantify the stability of a political structure when n n mediators are introduced, either one by one or simultaneously.

arxiv-2511-15712.title: Secure Autonomous Agent Payments: Verifying Authenticity and Intent in a Trustless Environment
arxiv-2511-15712.creator: Vivek Acharya
arxiv-2511-15712.description: Abstract Artificial intelligence (AI) agents are increasingly capable of initiating financial transactions on behalf of users or other agents. This shift raises a critical unsolved challenge: how to verify the authenticity of an AI agent and the true intent behind its transactions in a fully trustless, decentralized environment.

europmc-pmc3038199.title: Rho-kinase/ROCK: A key regulator of the cytoskeleton and cell polarity.
europmc-pmc3038199.creator: Amano M, Nakayama M, Kaibuchi K.
europmc-pmc3038199.description: Rho-associated kinase (Rho-kinase/ROCK/ROK) is an effector of the small GTPase Rho and belongs to the AGC family of kinases. Rho-kinase has pleiotropic functions including the regulation of cellular contraction, motility, morphology, polarity, cell division, and gene expression.

europmc-pmc8638446.title: Cancer associated-fibroblast-derived exosomes in cancer progression.
europmc-pmc8638446.creator: Li C, Teixeira AF, Zhu HJ, Ten Dijke P.
europmc-pmc8638446.description: To identify novel cancer therapies, the tumor microenvironment (TME) has received a lot of attention in recent years in particular with the advent of clinical successes achieved by targeting immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). The TME consists of multiple cell types that are...

pmc-10543126.title: Seroprevalence and detection of bovine leukosis virus in semen from breeding bulls in Costa Rica
pmc-10543126.creator: Jorge Chacón, Roberto Leiva, Juan José Romero-Zuñiga, Leonel Navarro, Gaby Dolz
pmc-10543126.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Bovine leukemia virus (BLV) causes enzootic bovine leukosis, a persistent infection and the most important neoplastic disease in cattle. It is spread primarily by transferring infected lymphocytes through blood from carriers to healthy animals. The present study is aimed at determining the seropositivity of BLV in breeding bulls from Costa Rica and at detecting for the first time in the country BLV DNA in bull semen.

pmc-11511308.title: Consecutive Image Acquisition without Anomalies
pmc-11511308.creator: Angel Mur, Patrice Galaup, Etienne Dedic, Dominique Henry, Hervé Aubert, Lu Liu, Jianjun Yin, Haiyong Weng, Yuwei Wang
pmc-11511308.description: An image is a visual representation that can be used to obtain information. A camera on a moving vector (e.g., on a rover, drone, quad, etc.) may acquire images along a controlled trajectory. The maximum visual information is captured during a fixed acquisition time when consecutive images do not overlap and have no space (or gap) between them.

pmc-11675927.title: Microbial and Sensory Quality Changes in Broiler Chicken Breast Meat During Refrigerated Storage
pmc-11675927.creator: Anna Augustyńska-Prejsnar, Miroslava Kačániová, Paweł Hanus, Zofia Sokołowicz, Mirosław Słowiński, Marco Antonio Trindade
pmc-11675927.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The aim of the study was to assess the bacterial flora of broiler chicken breast meat using the MALDI method, as well as its sensory evaluation while stored refrigerated at a stable temperature (0.5 °C+/−0.5 °C). Bacterial identification based on peptidic spectra obtained by matrix-assisted laser desorption ionisation time-of-flight (MALDI-TOF MS) mass spectrometry is a rapid, inexpensive, and accurate method for identifying isolates that belong to certain bacterial phyla.

pmc-12542022.title: “It’s like a car that doesn’t like gasoline” - a qualitative study of siblings’ understanding of anorexia nervosa in childhood: perspectives from siblings and parents
pmc-12542022.creator: Amalie Schumann, Torun M Vatne, Louise Dalton, Elizabeth Rapa, Krister W Fjermestad
pmc-12542022.description: BackgroundWhen adolescents develop anorexia nervosa (AN), this impacts the family system and puts healthy siblings at risk of mental health problems. Siblings need support and age-appropriate information about the diagnosis to prevent negative mental health outcomes. However, evidence-based support for siblings is limited.

pmc-12953187.title: Solid Subtype of Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma: A Case Series Highlighting Aggressive Features
pmc-12953187.creator: Rafael Castellanos Bueno, Gabriela Almeyda Carreño, Diana Carolina Vergara Arenas, Laura Yibeth Esteban Badillo, Ernesto García Ayala
pmc-12953187.description: Papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) is the most common malignant thyroid neoplasm. Its solid/trabecular subtype (STPTC) is rare, and its aggressiveness remains controversial. We describe the clinical, histopathological, and immunohistochemical characteristics of three STPTC cases, highlighting their biological behavior and impact on current classification.

pmc-13214177.title: Methodological heterogeneity and equity challenges of distributional cost-effectiveness analysis in healthcare: a systematic review from 2017 to 2025
pmc-13214177.creator: Xinyue Yuan, Jiaqi Shi, Qingqiu Wang, Ming Hu
pmc-13214177.description: BackgroundHealth equity has become a key focus of global health policy. Distributional cost-effectiveness analysis (DCEA) is one of the most commonly used methods for incorporating health equity into health economics evaluations. However, systematic reviews specifically on DCEA in healthcare remain scarce, and its research methods, findings, and quality have not been clearly summarized.

pmc-13387509.title: Subcellular Localization of Dopamine D1 and D2 Receptors in the Mouse Hippocampus
pmc-13387509.creator: Cameron B. Swope, Garrett Sommer, Ravon Smith, Teresa A. Milner, Jimcy Platholi
pmc-13387509.description: Dopamine signaling through dopamine 1 receptors (D1Rs) and dopamine 2 receptors (D2Rs) regulates hippocampal synaptic plasticity underlying learning and memory, yet their subcellular localization within the hippocampus is unknown. Here, we performed electron microscopic immunocytochemistry to elucidate the distribution of D1R and D2R in subregions of the mouse hippocampus.

pmc-13486503.title: High-speed hyperspectral single-pixel microscopy via line-scan detection with data fusion-based enhanced resolution
pmc-13486503.creator: Samuel I Zapata-Valencia, Heberley Tobón-Maya, Cosimo D’Andrea, Jesús Lancis, Enrique Tajahuerce
pmc-13486503.description: The development of hyperspectral microscopy techniques is recognized as an active field of research. Although commercial alternatives are available, these systems remain slow, expensive, and limited in flexibility, indicating clear opportunities for improvement. Coded‑imaging strategies, including single‑pixel imaging (SPI), offer promising alternatives by enabling computational reconstructions with spectral resolution through parallel detection.

pmc-13570004.title: Telitacicept for primary angiitis of the central nervous system: A real-world retrospective study
pmc-13570004.creator: Jiangyi Lyu, Yifan Wang, Fangfang Li, Shangtian Xiang, Jing Zhao, Yu He, Weizhou Zang
pmc-13570004.description: BackgroundPrimary central nervous system vasculitis (PACNS) is a rare inflammatory disease with limited treatment options. Telitacicept and high-resolution vessel wall imaging (HR-VWI) may offer new strategies for therapy and disease monitoring.ObjectiveTo evaluate the clinical efficacy and safety of telitacicept in patients with PACNS and to explore the value of HR-VWI in assessing disease activity.DesignA single-center retrospective study.
